verse.text: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light; those who dwelt in the land of the shadow of death, upon them a light has shined.
verse.encouragement: Even in seasons that feel heavy, God is still present, still faithful, and still making a way forward. May His light give you courage for today, peace for tomorrow, and hope that reaches beyond what you can see.
